scope: Proposed refinements for a later resumed campaign; no experiment admission, numerical gain prior or public forecast.

hypotheses.statement: Raw context plus causal normalized innovations may improve future-regime robustness, with an effect that depends on training mask concentration.
hypotheses.proposed_change: Compare raw, raw-plus-causal-moments, and raw-plus-moments-plus-innovations under a fixed current weighting; then cross the useful representation with one less-concentrated predeclared propensity/since weighting, one factor at a time.
hypotheses.expected_mechanism: Preserve level/regime information while giving a stable innovation representation; test whether historical weighting suppresses the rows that benefit.
hypotheses.claim_scope: Complete current student or fixed blend, multiple exposed folds and paired seeds; future transfer remains unconfirmed.
assumptions: Observable activity/source shifts contain nuisance variation
Running statistics are causal and trained with identical equations
Raw branch retains predictive distribution context
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Improved official complete-endpoint score or smaller matched deterioration under declared activity/source shifts without a large ordinary-CV loss.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Use fitting-only causal summary distributions and existing prediction residuals to choose two contrasts; run equal-capacity candidate/control on two contrasting outer folds before a factorial extension.
hypotheses.falsifier: No repeatable residual relationship or candidate loses to raw-plus-moments/shared-capacity control across folds; a smoother feature distribution alone is insufficient.
known_failure_modes: Selecting stress scenarios after leaderboard feedback

estimated_cost.relative: medium; matched student fits plus existing controls
estimated_cost.serving: small causal moments and input branch; actual native callback profile required

hypotheses.mechanism_family: path-order memory and causal activity-dependent forgetting
hypotheses.statement: A small path-order memory with a learned causal decay clock may retain inter-instrument lead-lag information that equal endpoints and row-clock states obscure.
hypotheses.proposed_change: Use low-dimensional causal instrument projections, displacement and signed-area state; a positive bounded feature-change clock affects exponential decay, window membership or time-channel areas. Preserve elapsed rows and process every input.
hypotheses.expected_mechanism: Represent order of innovations and adapt memory persistence to observed activity while maintaining fixed bounded inference state.
hypotheses.claim_scope: Refinement of existing path-area and clock proposals; not evidence against or repetition of the old second event-GRU screen.
assumptions: Anonymous input projections need no physical depth mapping
Activity clock is computed only from allowed history
hypotheses.predicted_observable: A fixed complete endpoint improves relative to displacement-only and fixed-decay-area controls, particularly on declared asynchronous-update regimes.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Algebraic equal-displacement/different-order and reset fixtures; verify pure time relabeling is invariant, then compare fixed decay and learned decay/time-channel controls with the same feature dimension and capacity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Clock only reparameterizes the same path and leaves areas unchanged, learned clock collapses without a useful simpler arm, or no complete-endpoint conditional gain survives matched folds.
known_failure_modes: Geometric path signatures are invariant under pure monotone time reparameterization
Forward-filled stale inputs create spurious events
A new feature merely duplicates existing GRU state

estimated_cost.relative: medium pilot; bounded low-dimensional streaming state
estimated_cost.serving: O(k squared) small-state update per row for small fixed k; no full history scan

hypotheses.statement: Projecting separately estimated weighted target moments into a causal student may improve on direct output distillation without assuming a universal target law.
hypotheses.proposed_change: Own teachers estimate E[S W Y|G] and E[S W|G] for clipped Y and W=abs(Y), using richer fitting-only context G. Cross-fit teacher predictions inside each outer fit set, project the two moments separately to allowed history H, use shrunk positive denominator and direct-regression fallback.
hypotheses.expected_mechanism: Transfer predictive parts of a richer teacher under the metric's weighted measure while separating expected magnitude from signed outcome; a hypothesis about finite-sample estimation, not extra information at inference.
hypotheses.claim_scope: Causal student improvement on outer excluded groups; teacher oracle score and representation loss alone do not support it.
assumptions: G contains H and genuinely useful fitting-only information
Moments are estimated well enough for a stable ratio
Unknown training scoring indicator requires an explicitly qualified in-fold approximation
No outer-evaluation rows enter teachers or normalization
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Causal student beats identical direct-WMSE and causal-output-distillation controls on official score; advantage survives direct-lookahead-teacher versus causal-teacher ablation.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Use a small source-qualified complete-component subset and short future horizon to test predictable teacher residual/moments; retain full-budget follow-up for a promising but uncertain arm.
hypotheses.falsifier: Only future-aware teacher improves, projected denominator destabilizes outputs, or causal student shows no useful standalone/conditional gain at matched cost.
known_failure_modes: E[ratio|H] is not ratio of projected moments
Applying outcome weights again to moment projection changes estimand
Teacher errors copied into the student

estimated_cost.relative: high; extra teacher fits, inner cross-fitting and student fits
estimated_cost.serving: Two moment heads per target or distill back to standard compact output; no future input

hypotheses.statement: Matching relationships between selected own-teacher states may compress complementary predictive structure more effectively than direct state-coordinate MSE.
hypotheses.proposed_change: Compare output-only, output-plus-coordinate, and output-plus-distance/angle distillation with the same student. Use bounded pairs/triples stratified by causal event age inside source-qualified fitting groups; never materialize all-pairs arrays.
hypotheses.expected_mechanism: Preserve task-relevant relationships without assuming teacher and student hidden-state coordinates align.
hypotheses.claim_scope: Refinement of registered relational and hidden-state proposals, conditional on a useful own teacher portfolio.
assumptions: Teacher geometry contains information beyond scalar predictions
Selected relationships correlate with task quality
Pair sampling does not mainly copy source identity
hypotheses.predicted_observable: The same compact student's official score or contribution to the frozen final blend improves across paired seeds/folds with no additional inference module.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Bounded one-fold paired student screen with teacher sidecars streamed at sparse fitting rows, then two-fold comparison if informative.
hypotheses.falsifier: Relations are matched but official student quality does not improve, or benefit disappears against coordinate/equal-capacity controls.
known_failure_modes: No clean ancestry for the teacher portfolio
